status: exploratory matched-update computational comparison, not conclusive efficiency or fairness benchmark
data: same 112 heldout-split sequences as generalization stage; 64/16/32
models: real graph uniform weights, three random sign seeds 7/17/27; same two RIA outputs and initial linear readout
training: same 32 preselected minibatch updates, batch 8 whole sequences, Adam lr .003, paired seed-specific batches; either actor only with cached states or chemical weights plus actor with full gradients through time, gap remains fixed; chemical mask fixed; Heun .05 s
validation: one terminal heldout score, no checkpoint selection; compare training elapsed and simulation/cache costs separately; no equal-quality efficiency claim
